{{Quote|Yes, sir.|Thrawn's subordinate|<ref name="TIE">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''Thrawn's subordinate''' was an officer who served [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He stood beside Thrawn's command chair and briefed Thrawn on several developments.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
With a mustache, he bears some resemblance to [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], who served Thrawn after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. However, it is not Pellaeon, as he did not meet Thrawn until after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

The game designers likely intended this to be a tribute to the [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|The Thrawn Trilogy]] novels written by [[Timothy Zahn]], which were published a few years before the release of [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. Indeed, some of the story of ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' was modeled after Zahn's work.<ref name="Gamespot">{{GameSpot|url=gamespot/features/all/greatestgames/p-55.html|text=Star Wars: TIE Fighter}}</ref>

On the other hand, the character may have actually been intended to be Pellaeon himself, making his appearance in ''TIE Fighter'' an error in light of previously established continuity.
